# Operations Data Platform

## Executive Summary

The company runs its scheduling and quoting on spreadsheets, and the analysis
below states each figure as the range it supports rather than as a point.

## Financial Analysis

### Current State

The company reported LTM revenue of $84.0M–$88.0M for the trailing twelve months, the spread being two disputed contracts, and adjusted EBITDA of $12.6M over the same period.

Average quote turnaround runs 9 days against an industry norm nearer three, and
on-time delivery sits at 71% across the last four quarters.

### Projected Impact

In the Conservative case the platform carries an EBITDA margin impact of 0.9–1.9pp, worth $900K–$1.8M a year against the current revenue base.

In the Base Case it carries an EBITDA margin impact of 3.1pp, worth $1.8M–$2.9M a year.

In the Optimistic case it carries an EBITDA margin impact of 4.1 to 4.9pp, worth $3.8M–$4.6M a year.

## The Proposed Solution

Pricing rules move out of the spreadsheet and into a rules engine every quote
is priced against.
